initialization: raw reference frame zero and canonical finite-difference velocities
reference_velocity: centered generalized-position difference at plus/minus one source interval; one-sided at endpoints

failure.comparison: strict greater-than; absolute world-z error and absolute projected unit-gravity z difference in robot/reference root frames; no end-effector termination

scoring_time: post-physics state at same reference timestamp, including exact final source timestamp
warning: All clips continue to the exact final timestamp after tracking failure. Success still requires no failure at any sample. Completion remains the uninterrupted fraction before first failure. Metrics cover the entire motion, including post-failure states. Infrastructure or nonfinite states invalidate a run.

position_alignment_definition.no_alignment: raw world positions; no fitted or initial transform
position_alignment_definition.xy: subtract each actual/reference pelvis XY; keep absolute world Z and orientation
position_alignment_definition.xy_yaw: XY centering followed by closest world-Z rotation from actual to reference pelvis orientation; preserve Z and tilt
position_alignment_definition.yaw_rule: M=R_ref*R_actual^T; angle=atan2(M[1,0]-M[0,1],M[0,0]+M[1,1]); ambiguity if hypot of atan2 arguments <=1e-12; use angle=0, retain sample and expose fraction
position_alignment_definition.legacy_xyz: mpjpe_root_relative_world_axes_m remains a separately named translation-only compatibility diagnostic; not one of the three headline modes
position_alignment_definition.aggregation: Mean Euclidean distance across the same 14 body origins, then mean over all metric samples through the exact endpoint; macro mean across clips. Failure checks and alignment are unchanged.

allowed: joint positions and velocities in named order
ideal root-body-origin linear and angular velocity in world axes
local FK from joint state and fixed robot geometry
reference motion including world pose, velocities and declared history/future window
previous actions and author-native recurrent/proprioceptive history
forbidden: actual global root translation XYZ, including measured height
actual global body positions or position error derived from actual translation
actual contact flags, forces, impulses or dynamics-only state
explicit integration of actual velocity into displacement
odometry, root-position estimators, contact-aided position estimation
actual position through initialization, reset, reference alignment, cached state or side channels
observation_rules.reference_rule: Reference packets come only from the frozen motion and robot geometry; never align or recenter using measured translation. Author reference-only transformations must be disclosed.
observation_rules.special_cases: Constant synthetic origins, reference-only anchoring and local FK require a per-checkpoint author-supported or numerically equivalent inference path; no arbitrary zeroing of a required actor input.
observation_rules.memory_rule: Native history/recurrent state is allowed; explicit position-estimation code is not. This does not prove absence of implicit displacement inference inside a network.
observation_rules.admission: Exact weight and auxiliary-artifact hashes, pinned author source, full reset/history/action audit, forbidden-input dependency test, inference parity and independently verified fresh full-suite run.
observation_rules.scope: Ideal noise-free proprioception, not a claim of real-world sensor feasibility; training critic/reward/teacher privilege is outside deployment input restrictions.
